restrictions: Messages are exactly 64 bytes: one chunk, one block, one root compression with flags CHUNK_START|CHUNK_END|ROOT = 11, block length 64, chunk counter 0 and output counter 0.
Deterministic straight-line construction with no randomness, search, restart or loop; it always outputs a colliding pair, so success probability is exactly 1.
The two messages differ only in message words 9 and 13; words 8 and 12 are solved so that the intermediate c1 of diagonal G(0,5,10,15) and of diagonal G(2,7,8,13) is 0.
Scored algorithm fixes every free message word (0-7, 9, 10, 11, 13, 14, 15) to zero; any other fixed values, and target c1 = 2^31 for either G, work identically (Section 3).

No full target compression is evaluated. Every G-function step is charged as word operations at 1/222 each, including all loads and stores, under the classical 256-bit word RAM of collision-frontier-v5.

Explicit tally: 264 arithmetic/logical/shift operations plus 144 loads/stores plus at most 8 control operations, at most 416 operations, i.e. at most 1.874 target-compression units; the claimed 2^1.5 = 2.83 units (628 operations) leaves headroom for stricter operation conventions (Section 5).
Two executed witnesses are supplied as certificates; they are reproducibility evidence for the construction, not a stored collision used by the algorithm.
baseline_improved names the organizer nominal reference; the claimed bound 1.5 is below both that nominal 128 and the organizer's generic package (149).
